Increases flood hazards risks for A Zone, increases flood insurance requirements, and
requires upgrades to meet current FEMA regulations where the cost of any new work
or addition or the cost to repair damage is more than 50 % of the assessed value of
structure before damaged.

Increases flood hazards risks for V Zone, increases flood insurance requirements,
rebuilding not permitted in V zones where cost to repair or replace is more than 50%
of assessed value of structure before damaged. Improvements are also limited to less
than 50% of assess value of structure
